title: setup-tool tool manifest
description: Files that setup-tool syncs between this tool's folder and the home folder.

enabled.description: Set to false to leave this tool out of setup-tool entirely.

destinationRoot.description: Base folder for relative destinations, e.g. $HOME/.pi. $NAME and ${NAME} are environment variables; $HOME is the home folder on every OS.

source.description: Path next to this manifest, starting with the platform folder that decides where it applies: common (everywhere), posix (macOS, Linux, WSL), linux (Linux, WSL), macos, wsl or windows. A folder syncs every file under it.

destination.description: Where the source is installed: relative to destinationRoot, or absolute, e.g. $APPDATA/Code/User/settings.json. Uses the same variables as destinationRoot.
